name: technical_issue_handoff
branch: E432's dashboards do not load after a grant. Expected: an IT handoff.
tests: Does the agent escalate technical failures to human IT operations via an IT handoff ticket?
instruction: You are Monica Geller (employee ID E432). You were granted viewer access on Reporting Application (APP-RPT), but when you log in your dashboards fail to load with a 500 error. Report this technical issue to the IT access desk and request an IT escalation ticket.

persona.name: Monica Geller
persona.initial_message: Hello IT desk, this is Monica Geller (E432). I have active viewer access on Reporting Application (APP-RPT), but my dashboards fail to load with a 500 server error. Can you escalate this to IT operations?

arguments.details: Dashboards failing to load despite active viewer entitlement
